name: Man Looking for Slippers / Temple Chappal Confusion
visual_description: A shirtless young man stands looking helplessly at dozens of identical blue and white flip-flops scattered on the floor by a shoe rack.
usage_context: Used to express confusion, indecisiveness, or frustration when trying to pick one's own item from dozens of identical options, like after visiting a temple.

example.top_text: Me outside the temple on Tuesday
example.bottom_text: Trying to find the brand new chappal I wore
